seo.title: Walking and cycling around Cour-Cheverny
seo.description: Explore walking and cycling routes around Cour-Cheverny, Cheverny, Chambord and the Sologne countryside.

hero.title: Follow the paths, not the clock.
hero.description: Quiet cycle lanes, marked loops and Sologne paths make the area ideal for relaxed outdoor adventures.
hero.imageAlt: Cyclists on a quiet Loire Valley road
hero.imageCaption: The Loire Valley through the seasons

intro.title: Every route can become a leisurely outing.
intro.text: The house is close to local cycle paths and marked routes. Follow the official links for current maps, equipment advice and conditions.

map.title: Choose your next outing from the house.
map.text: Filter the markers and select one for details. Walking and cycling markers indicate route starts or loop areas.
